title: THOS: A Benchmark Dataset for Targeted Hate and Offensive Speech
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark dataset for targeted hate speech. It explicitly identifies 'religion' as a top-level target class (TPC) for hate speech, with specific sub-topics including 'Muslim', 'Christian', and 'Jewish'. The dataset collection method also used keywords related to these religions. The paper discusses how mocking 'somebody's religion' is considered hate speech, making the evaluation of religion-targeted content a core component.
